title: Comu Fits a 144MHz CH32V203 RISC-V Board Inside a USB-A Port

content_html:
Tindie recently listed Comu, a compact development board built around the WCH CH32V203 RISC-V microcontroller. Measuring 13 × 9.4mm, the board fits inside a USB-A port and combines programmable touch controls, LEDs, USB device support, and access to several GPIO signals.

The CH32V203 operates at up to 144MHz using its internal oscillator and provides 224KB of application flash, 24KB of boot flash, and 20KB of SRAM. Other integrated features include a 12-bit ADC, DMA controller, touch-sensing hardware, and a full-speed USB peripheral.

— ADVERTISEMENT —



CH32V203 block diagram
(click image to enlarge)

Comu includes four capacitive-touch inputs formed along the castellated board edges, along with two white LEDs. Six additional GPIO pins are exposed through test pads, allowing the board to be incorporated into other hardware or used for compact embedded experiments.

The board connects directly to a USB-A port and can operate as a USB Human Interface Device. Suggested applications include keyboard macros, volume controls, screen-capture buttons, computer sleep controls, and other programmable shortcuts. Its USB peripheral can also be accessed at a lower level for experimenting with raw USB packets and inspecting traffic using tools such as usbmon and Wireshark.


Comu top and bottom view
(click image to enlarge)

A custom 2KB USB bootloader is installed at the factory. Because the board lacks a dedicated BOOT0 button, the bootloader remains active for five seconds after connection before launching the user application. Programs are linked and flashed at address 0x800, with the supplied Makefiles handling the required offset.


Comu demo
(click image to enlarge)

The primary development environment is ch32fun, a lightweight framework for bare-metal C and C++ development on WCH microcontrollers. The project repository includes examples for blinking the LEDs, capacitive-touch input, formatted output, USB TTY, USB HID, and USB mass-storage operation.

Alternative development options include Rust through ch32-hal, Arduino through arduino_core_ch32, WCH’s HAL and MounRiver Studio II, and USB libraries such as TinyUSB.


Comu size comparison
(click image to enlarge)

The hardware design, bootloader, enclosure files, examples, and documentation are available through the project’s public GitHub repository. The design credits the earlier Tomu development board as inspiration for its USB-port form factor.

Specifications listed for Comu include:

  • Processor:
    • WCH CH32V203 32-bit RISC-V microcontroller
      • Up to 144MHz
  • Memory:
    • 224KB application flash
    • 24KB boot flash
    • 20KB SRAM
    • 64KB zero-wait-state flash
  • USB:
    • Full-speed USB peripheral
    • Integrated USB-A edge connector
    • USB HID, serial, and mass-storage examples
    • Custom 2KB USB bootloader
  • I/O:
    • 4× capacitive-touch inputs
    • 2× white LEDs
    • 6× GPIO signals exposed through test pads
    • 12-bit ADC
    • DMA controller
  • Mechanical:
    • 13 × 9.4mm
    • 0.4g with case
    • 0.2g without case

Further Information

Comu is available from Icy Electronics through Tindie for $5.99, with quantity pricing as low as $3.59 per board.

content_html_zh:
Tindie 最近上市了 Comu，这是一款围绕 WCH CH32V203 RISC-V 微控制器构建的紧凑型开发板。 该板尺寸为 13 × 9.4 毫米，安装在 USB-A 端口内，并结合了可编程触摸控制、LED、USB 设备支持以及对多个 GPIO 信号的访问。

CH32V203 使用其内部振荡器工作频率高达 144MHz，并提供 224KB 应用闪存、24KB 启动闪存和 20KB SRAM。 其他集成功能包括 12 位 ADC、DMA 控制器、触摸感应硬件和全速 USB 外设。

- 广告 -


CH32V203框图（点击图片放大）

Comu 包括四个沿城堡形板边缘形成的电容式触摸输入以及两个白色 LED。 六个额外的 GPIO 引脚通过测试焊盘暴露出来，允许该板合并到其他硬件中或用于紧凑的嵌入式实验。

该板直接连接到 USB-A 端口，并可作为 USB 人机接口设备运行。 建议的应用程序包括键盘宏、音量控制、屏幕捕获按钮、计算机睡眠控制和其他可编程快捷方式。 还可以在较低级别访问其 USB 外设，以试验原始 USB 数据包并使用 usbmon 和 Wireshark 等工具检查流量。

Comu俯视图和仰视图（点击图片放大）

工厂安装了定制的 2KB USB 引导加载程序。 由于该板缺少专用的 BOOT0 按钮，因此引导加载程序在连接后保持活动状态五秒钟，然后再启动用户应用程序。 程序在地址 0x800 处链接和刷新，并使用提供的 Makefile 处理所需的偏移量。

Comu演示（点击图片放大）

主要开发环境是 ch32fun，这是一个用于在 WCH 微控制器上进行裸机 C 和 C++ 开发的轻量级框架。 该项目存储库包括 LED 闪烁、电容式触摸输入、格式化输出、USB TTY、USB HID 和 USB 大容量存储操作的示例。

替代开发选项包括 Rust 通过 ch32-hal、Arduino 通过 arduino_core_ch32、WCH 的 HAL 和 MounRiver Studio II 以及 USB 库（例如 TinyUSB）。

Comu尺寸对比（点击图片放大）

硬件设计、引导加载程序、附件文件、示例和文档可通过该项目的公共 GitHub 存储库获取。 该设计将早期的 Tomu 开发板作为其 USB 端口外形的灵感来源。

Comu 列出的规格包括：

  • 处理器：WCH CH32V203 32位RISC-V微控制器高达144MHz
  • 内存： 224KB 应用闪存 24KB 启动闪存 20KB SRAM 64KB 零等待状态闪存
  • USB：全速 USB 外设 集成 USB-A 边缘连接器 USB HID、串行和大容量存储示例 定制 2KB USB 引导加载程序
  • I/O： 4 个电容式触摸输入 2 个白色 LED 6 个通过测试焊盘暴露的 GPIO 信号 12 位 ADC DMA 控制器
  • 机械：13 × 9.4mm 0.4g（带外壳） 0.2g（不带外壳）

更多信息

Comu 可通过 Tindie 从 Icy Electronics 购买，价格为 5.99 美元，批量定价低至每板 3.59 美元。
